question: Does mapped initialization of immutable reference points and flat nodes improve complete cold C2C RPC without warm regression?

protocol.question: Does mapped initialization of immutable reference points and ordinary flat nodes reduce complete cold production C2C RPC without warm regression?
protocol.candidate: Same ordinary GPU shader and exact f64 verification. Opt-in mappedAtCreation for immutable points/selected nodes with exact byte-range copies, unmap and cleanup. Separate upload-mode search caches share the ordinary device and exact verifier pool. Query/readback and optional box/parent uploads keep queued paths.
protocol.warmScope: Complete ordinary production Worker RPC, including fresh query snapshot, GPU dispatch/readback, exact streaming worker verification, ordered statistics, f32 export and response transfer. Both upload-mode search caches and the shared verifier pool are prepared; diagnostics and phase probe are absent.
protocol.coldScope: After warm pairs, four balanced cold pairs per report. Reload each reference outside RPC; include complete fresh exact reference/tree/export/upload/verifier preparation and full RPC. Follow each cold RPC immediately with a same-mode cached RPC. Device, pipeline and CPU pool are warm; parsing/index is excluded.
protocol.orderScheme: Alternating queued/mapped and mapped/queued warm pairs gives six timed pairs per position. Cold pair order alternates within each report, with reversed starts on the repeated dataset. Retain every tail.

adoptionGate.definition: Per report median(mapped/queued) on four cold pairs <=0.95 and >=3/4 cold wins, plus median(mapped/queued) on twelve primary warm pairs <=1.02 and on four immediate cached follow-up pairs <=1.05. All four reports must pass. Otherwise queued remains default.

protocol.correctness: 28 Node cases; 37 software E2E cases covered by 35 passing unchanged cases plus 2 repaired test-prelude cases, and 8 physical E2E cases. Direct real 261-query/brute f64 parity, 7830 raw mapped hint slots, byte-offset ownership, both node formats, lazy retries, all workgroups/traversals, buffered snapshots/mutations, four production failure/retry directions and device-loss fallback. Four ordinary Worker flat/packed software/physical smokes plus twelve compatibility smokes. Test prelude syntax/name repairs consume no timing reports.
protocol.memory: Both modes select the same 20-byte flat nodes. A requested search retains only its selected node representation until a format switch; no host export is retained. Warm comparison keeps separate queued/mapped point/node/batch caches; at most two upload modes by two diagnostic settings per immutable reference. This is not total device memory or transfer-traffic measurement.
protocol.wasmReuse: Complete unchanged Rust source set and four byte-identical WASM/glue artifacts checked before frontend reuse; fresh full WASM compilation remains in CI.
protocol.safety: No new toolchains or data downloads. Byte-identical real measured even/odd subsets, physical adapter-class guard in page and Worker, one ordinary device, no timestamp negotiation or adapter identity. No other heavy work during timings. All earlier budgets remain closed.

conclusion: Mapped initialization remains opt-in. Two reports pass the frozen joint gate. Cold paired reductions range from -13.89 to 46.69 percent and primary warm regressions reach 2.71 percent. Twelve of sixteen cold pairs are faster, but the repeated results do not establish a stable benefit. Every sample is retained; no isolated physical transfer duration or driver/GC cause is inferred.
